reason: A DSH plugin that improves chat-session loading by caching reads, prewarming recent sessions, invalidating changed entries, and coalescing writes to selected projection-cache storage.

summaries.zh: 通过缓存会话读取、预热最近会话、精确失效和合并投影缓存写入来提升 DSH 聊天记录加载效率的插件。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin that improves chat history loading through session-read caching, recent-session prewarming, precise invalidation, and coalesced projection-cache writes.

capabilities: Caches session inspection results and session lists in memory
Reads local session storage for inspection and prewarming
Batches writes to designated fail-soft projection cache storage
Patches existing DSH service methods and configuration
